what: Phase 1 plan: P2 sv_graph_god_nodes, P4 expose confidence, P3 token budget + hub suppression
why: After analyzing Graphify's approach to token reduction, we identified 10 improvements. Phase 1 enriches the existing graph with god nodes, confidence exposure, and token budget control — all leveraging data already stored in SQLite.
learned: sv-memory already has confidence, communities, and centrality data stored but not exposed. The highest-impact improvements are: (1) exposing god nodes as a standalone tool, (2) showing confidence tags on edges, (3) adding token budget + hub suppression to prevent graph query explosion. These are all low-effort because the data already exists.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
next_steps: P2: Create sv_graph_god_nodes MCP tool. P4: Add confidence tags to sv_graph_query, sv_graph_explain, sv_graph_path outputs. P3: Add token_budget parameter + hub suppression to sv_graph_query.
